verses.original: הַ֥לְלוּ יָ֨הּ׀ אוֹדֶ֣ה יְ֭הוָה בְּכָל־ לֵבָ֑ב בְּס֖וֹד יְשָׁרִ֣ים וְעֵדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hal·lū yāh ’ō·w·ḏeh Yah·weh bə·ḵāl lê·ḇāḇ bə·sō·wḏ yə·šā·rîm wə·‘ê·ḏāh
verses.literal: Hallelujah . . . I will give thanks to the LORD with all my heart in the council of the upright and in the assembly

verses.original: גְּ֭דֹלִים מַעֲשֵׂ֣י יְהוָ֑ה דְּ֝רוּשִׁ֗ים לְכָל־ חֶפְצֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: gə·ḏō·lîm ma·‘ă·śê Yah·weh də·rū·šîm lə·ḵāl ḥep̄·ṣê·hem
verses.literal: Great are the works of the LORD they are pondered by all who delight in them

verses.original: הוֹד־ וְהָדָ֥ר פָּֽעֳל֑וֹ וְ֝צִדְקָת֗וֹ עֹמֶ֥דֶת לָעַֽד׃
verses.literal: Splendid and majestic is His work His righteousness endures forever

verses.original: זֵ֣כֶר עָ֭שָׂה לְנִפְלְאֹתָ֑יו חַנּ֖וּן וְרַח֣וּם יְהוָֽה׃
verses.literal: He has caused His wonders to be remembered the LORD is gracious and compassionate

verses.original: טֶ֭רֶף נָתַ֣ן לִֽירֵאָ֑יו יִזְכֹּ֖ר לְעוֹלָ֣ם בְּרִיתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ṭe·rep̄ nā·ṯan lî·rê·’āw yiz·kōr lə·‘ō·w·lām bə·rî·ṯōw
verses.literal: He provides food for those who fear Him He remembers His covenant forever

verses.original: כֹּ֣חַ מַ֭עֲשָׂיו הִגִּ֣יד לְעַמּ֑וֹ לָתֵ֥ת לָ֝הֶ֗ם נַחֲלַ֥ת גּוֹיִֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kō·aḥ ma·‘ă·śāw hig·gîḏ lə·‘am·mōw lā·ṯêṯ lā·hem na·ḥă·laṯ gō·w·yim
verses.literal: He has shown His people the power of His works by giving them the inheritance of the nations

verses.original: מַעֲשֵׂ֣י יָ֭דָיו אֱמֶ֣ת וּמִשְׁפָּ֑ט נֶ֝אֱמָנִ֗ים כָּל־ פִּקּוּדָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: ma·‘ă·śê yā·ḏāw ’ĕ·meṯ ū·miš·pāṭ ne·’ĕ·mā·nîm kāl- piq·qū·ḏāw
verses.literal: The works of His hands are truth and justice all His precepts are trustworthy

verses.original: סְמוּכִ֣ים לָעַ֣ד לְעוֹלָ֑ם עֲ֝שׂוּיִ֗ם בֶּאֱמֶ֥ת וְיָשָֽׁר׃
verses.literal: They are upheld forever and ever enacted in truth and uprightness

verses.original: פְּד֤וּת׀ שָׁ֘לַ֤ח לְעַמּ֗וֹ צִוָּֽה־ לְעוֹלָ֥ם בְּרִית֑וֹ קָד֖וֹשׁ וְנוֹרָ֣א שְׁמֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: pə·ḏūṯ šā·laḥ lə·‘am·mōw ṣiw·wāh- lə·‘ō·w·lām bə·rî·ṯōw qā·ḏō·wōš wə·nō·w·rā šə·mōw
verses.literal: He has sent redemption to His people He has ordained His covenant forever holy and awesome is His name

verses.original: רֵ֘אשִׁ֤ית חָכְמָ֨ה׀ יִרְאַ֬ת יְהוָ֗ה שֵׂ֣כֶל ט֭וֹב לְכָל־ עֹשֵׂיהֶ֑ם תְּ֝הִלָּת֗וֹ עֹמֶ֥דֶת לָעַֽד׃
verses.transliteration: rê·šîṯ ḥāḵ·māh yir·’aṯ Yah·weh śê·ḵel ṭō·wḇ lə·ḵāl ‘ō·śê·hem tə·hil·lā·ṯōw ‘ō·me·ḏeṯ lā·‘aḏ
verses.literal: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom all who follow His precepts gain rich understanding His praise endures forever
